# Tests that already fail on main on GitHub-hosted runners, excluded from both
# pytest steps of the `tests` job in .github/workflows/ci.yml. An entry with
# `::` is passed to --deselect, which matches node ID prefixes; a bare path is
# a module that fails at import and is passed to --ignore.
#
# Taken from main run 40363756269 (05b62b47, 2026-10-26). Runs 40084107273
# (2026-10-24) and 39980425672 (2026-10-23) failed on the same tests, apart
# from tests changed between those commits. With these excluded, a red
# `tests (py3.12, cpu)` on a pull request means a new failure (#3140).
#
# Remove an entry when its test passes on hosted runners. Do not add an entry
# to get a pull request through the queue.
